room_rent.note: Domestic cover: room rent at actuals with no sub-limit. International cover: Single Private Air-Conditioned Room.

icu.note: Both domestic and international: ICU at actual expenses charged by hospital.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment on inpatient claims. 20% co-pay applies only on optional Dental Plan Benefits (international).

sub_limits.note: Domestic: AYUSH capped (INR 5L-7.5L depending on SI), Air Ambulance up to schedule limit, Rehabilitation INR 50,000, Living Donor USD 30,000 (intl). Most core inpatient up to SI.

deductible.note: No deductible by default. Optional aggregate deductible of USD 500 or USD 1,000 available on international inpatient benefits for premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disease waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 35 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Applies to domestic cover SI only. 20% per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduced by 20% if claim made in a year with accumulated bonus.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Domestic cover: 60 days pre-hospitalisation. International cover: 45 days.

post_hosp.note: Domestic cover: 180 days post-hospitalisation. International cover: 90 days.

day_care.note: Extensive list of 390+ day care procedures covered under Annexure I.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is defined in the policy but not listed as a covered benefit in the Table of Benefits.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient covered under domestic plan up to INR 5L (for 37.5L SI) to INR 7.5L (for higher SI). Not covered under international plan.

organ_donor.note: Living donor medical costs covered: USD 30,000 (international Imperial Plan); INR 5,00,000 (domestic).

ambulance.note: Local road ambulance covered up to SI for both domestic and international. Air ambulance covered up to USD 7,500 (international Imperial Plan) and up to SI (domestic).

modern_treatments.note: Modern treatments per Annexure III (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, etc.) covered up to SI.

consumables.note: Non-medical items per Annexure II are excluded. Medical consumables used during surgery/hospitalisation are covered as part of inpatient treatment.

global_cover.note: International inpatient cover is a core part of this policy. Area of cover is worldwide outside India, with or without USA as specified in schedule.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no look-back applied; claims not contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed per IRDAI guidelines. Migration/portability for global policy requires existing policy to cover both domestic and international health.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, OPD treatment (domestic), sterility/infertility, dental (except accident inpatient), external congenital anomalies, hair loss treatment, sleep disorders (non-apnoea)
optional_riders: Dental Plan (international, 20% co-pay): dental treatment, surgery, periodontics outside India; Optional aggregate deductible (USD 500/1000) on international inpatient
